details: On August 31, 2026, Bitcoin traded near $77,900, demonstrating resilience despite escalating US-Iran conflict that pushed oil prices above $90 per barrel and placed pressure on global stocks. Bitcoin notably gained approximately 23% in August, outperforming traditional assets like gold and the Nasdaq, although it remains susceptible to broader market shifts. The Federal Reserve's hawkish stance and upcoming US jobs report on September 4 are also key factors influencing investor sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Resilient Amid US-Iran Tensions and Rising Oil Prices

details: Bitcoin reached approximately $78,400 on August 31, 2026, marking a significant 24% gain for the month, its best August performance since 2017. This rally was largely attributed to substantial inflows of $1.92 billion into U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) and $6.55 billion in short liquidations across the cryptocurrency market. The U.S. Treasury's plans for increased bond buybacks starting September 9 could provide a supportive macroeconomic backdrop.
title: Bitcoin Sees Strongest August Gain Since 2017, Driven by ETF Inflows

details: Ethereum experienced a 34% rally over the past month, surpassing the performance of many other major cryptocurrencies and trading in the range of $2,440–$2,465. Analyst Tom Lee forecasts that Ethereum could potentially reach $6,000 by the end of 2026, provided Bitcoin achieves a price of $150,000. This projection is largely driven by an anticipated increase in the ETH/BTC ratio.
title: Analyst Predicts Ethereum Could Hit $6,000 by 2026 if Bitcoin Reaches $150,000
